1. Obtain 5 dark oak planks. According to the recipe, crafting 1 dark oak plank requires 1 dark oak log. So, find or gather one dark oak log and craft it into dark oak planks.
2. Craft 5 dark oak planks using 1 dark oak log. This will leave you with no remaining log, ready for the next step.
3. With 5 dark oak planks, use these to craft 1 dark oak boat.

1. Gather 1 dark oak log.
2. Craft 1 dark oak log into 5 dark oak planks.
3. Use those 5 dark oak planks to craft 1 dark oak boat.

By following this logic, you'll have successfully crafted the dark oak boat.
